newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's VSM says plans Eurobond in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Russia's VSM says plans Eurobond in 1998.

text.p: Russia's RAO Vysokoskorostnye Magistrali (VSM or High-Speed Railways in English) plans to make a Eurobond issue in 1998, Deputy Finance Department Head Andrei Nikandrov told Reuters on Monday.
He gave no more details of the issue.
VSM is the only Russian company in which government-backed corporate bonds are traded.

The company has so far issued 510 billion roubles ($88.45 million) worth of bonds and plans to issue 200 billion roubles VSM is raising funds to build a high-speed railway link between Moscow and St Petersburg.
